name: worldtree wood
enchant_note: Wood from the axis of the world: all the realms' magic runs through it.
protection_note: A shield's worldtree wood: held, not worn, so it guards with its AC alone.
lore_descriptor: pale wood from the ash at the axis of the world, and hard to look at steadily
first_pickup_chronicle: A shield from the Worldtree. Yggdrasil, Ashvattha, Eden, pick your myth. Behind it, fire and frost remember their manners.
